description: This file defines the SuiteScriptLoader class which provides functionality to combine multiple script files into a single string. It includes basic access control and references to external PHP functions for file reading.

classes.name: SuiteScriptLoader
classes.description: Class that provides methods to manipulate scripts, specifically combining multiple scripts into one string.

methods.name: combineScripts
methods.description: Concatenates the contents of multiple script files into a single string, separated by newlines.
